contracts.commit_point: The guard executes at workflow.py:343-344 in run_tool_call, before the dispatch map is built and before execute_with_tool_audit invokes the executor; the filesystem effect commits when executor() runs (tooling.py:116) and the tool performs its effect — src.rename(dst) (filesystem.py:48), target.unlink() (filesystem.py:58), mkdir + handle.write (filesystem.py:64-67), target.read_text (filesystem.py:81), target.mkdir (filesystem.py:87), and base.iterdir/stat listing (filesystem.py:25-35) — reached via dispatch_map[name](**args) at workflow.py:366-368.
contracts.declared_mechanism: enforce_workspace_scope_for_fs (aiagent/tooling.py:88-100) resolves both workspace and candidate dir_path and raises ValueError on escape; it is invoked in run_tool_call (aiagent/workflow.py:343-344) when restrict_filesystem_to_workspace is true and project_root is non-None, after validate_tool_arguments (workflow.py:341-342) and before _build_dispatch_map/_execute/execute_with_tool_audit (workflow.py:346-378). The flag is config-driven and defaults enabled: FILESYSTEM_WORKSPACE_ONLY parses to True by default (aiagent/env.py:89; RuntimeConfig field at env.py:19). Each tool additionally enforces per-directory containment of the file argument via _resolve_in_dir (aiagent/tools/filesystem.py:9-16).
contracts.forbidden_condition: Any of the six filesystem tools in _FILESYSTEM_TOOL_NAMES (tooling.py:19-26) being dispatched where arguments['dir_path'] is absent or empty (ValueError 'requires dir_path within workspace') or where Path(raw_dir_path).expanduser().resolve() is not relative_to(project_root.expanduser().resolve()) (ValueError 'dir_path escapes workspace'). Defense-in-depth forbidden condition inside the tools: a name/filename/old_name/new_name argument whose resolved target escapes the tool's resolved dir_path ('Path escapes the target directory').
pending_binding_information: No supplied source shows the production call sites that load RuntimeConfig and pass restrict_filesystem_to_workspace and a non-None project_root into executechainedtoolcall, complete_after_tool_results, or run_tool_call, so end-to-end default-on wiring from FILESYSTEM_WORKSPACE_ONLY is unconfirmed.
Whether run_tool_call is the sole runtime execution path for the six filesystem tools (no alternative dispatch site appears in the supplied views, but repository enumeration is not complete).
Whether relative dir_path arguments occur in operation and whether CWD-relative resolution matches the intended workspace anchoring.
contracts.protected_operation: Dispatch and execution of agent tool calls for list_dir, rename_file, delete_file, write_file, read_file, and create_dir inside run_tool_call's _execute closure, executed via execute_with_tool_audit.
contracts.protected_resource: Files and directories under the resolved project_root workspace (the workspace containment boundary), including their contents and metadata exposed by reads/listings.
contracts.protection_obligation: Agent-invoked filesystem tools (list_dir, rename_file, delete_file, write_file, read_file, create_dir) must not be executed with a dir_path that resolves outside the project workspace: run_tool_call must invoke enforce_workspace_scope_for_fs (rejecting escaping, missing, or empty dir_path values) after argument validation and before the tool dispatches and commits its filesystem effect inside execute_with_tool_audit. Merged from first- and second-phase reviewer wording, which describes the same registered workspace-containment guard.
scope_limits: Enforcement is conditional: the guard runs only when restrict_filesystem_to_workspace is true and project_root is non-None (workflow.py:343); run_tool_call and executechainedtoolcall signatures default these to False/None, while env.py:89 defaults the env flag to True.

enforce_workspace_scope_for_fs validates only arguments['dir_path']; containment of filename/old_name/new_name/name arguments is delegated to _resolve_in_dir inside each tool, not to the workspace guard.
The guard covers only the six names in _FILESYSTEM_TOOL_NAMES; other tools (web, weather, skills, history/search_history, anythingllmquery, get_system_datetime) are out of this obligation's scope.
The workspace check exists only on the run_tool_call path; direct invocation of the filesystem tool functions elsewhere would receive only the per-directory _resolve_in_dir check.
The guard fails closed on missing/empty dir_path for the six filesystem tools (tooling.py:92-93).

Relative dir_path values are resolved against the process working directory (Path.resolve in tooling.py:96 and filesystem.py:10-11), not against project_root, so CWD determines whether relative paths pass.
The tool-call audit log containment (tooling.py:139-145) is a separate mechanism and is not part of this contract.
